newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro falls 2.8 pct after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro falls 2.8 pct after H1 results.

text.p: Norwegian industrial giant Norsk Hydro ASA fell 2.8 percent on Monday after the company posted a 4.5 percent decline in pre-tax profits in first half 1997.
At 0842 GMT Hydro was down 11 crowns at 387 crowns in turnover of 38.8 million crowns. The stock dipped to an intraday low at 385 crowns shortly after the market opened.

Hydro posted an operating result in the first six months of 5.98 billion crowns and pre-tax profits of 5.87 billion crowns. A Reuters poll of nine analysts forecast a first half operating result of 6.07 billion crowns and pre-tax profits of 6.09 billion.

Dealers said the results were mainly in line with expectations apart from the agriculture division, which was slightly below forecasts. Generally weaker stock markets worldwide also were weighing on the stock, they said.
